notes.subject: שקפים אטמים
notes.rationale: Famous crux: 'windows of narrow lights' (KJV), 'broad within narrow without' (Geneva/JPS), 'fixed lattice-work' (ASV) — the two rare words describe framed, restricted openings.

notes.subject: שקוף
notes.rationale: שקוף occurs only here and in its parallel (2 Chr 3:5 Ezek 40:16ff); a rare architectural term.

translation: A ye so kɛ finibɔyɔrɔw ye minnu ka da bɔ dɔgɔya fɛ, dakuna ɲumanw ye.
